messages:
Ellie (People Ops): Quick heads-up: open enrollment window for benefits has a minor policy update and a required verification step for dependents. Enrollment window: Oct 10-24. Please review the handbook note and have managers confirm dependent docs by Oct 28. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/benefits-enroll-2026 :spiral_calendar: 

Noah (Benefits): Short Q who needs to submit documents? Only folks adding dependents or changing coverage tiers?

Ellie (People Ops): Exactly only employees who add a dependent, switch plans, or enroll in FSA/HSA need to upload proof. Existing coverage with no changes doesnt need new docs. We added examples in the handbook.

Samir (Legal): For audits we need a record: manager confirmation, employee id, doc type, submission timestamp. People Ops please ensure exports include a hash or filename and ticket id if any exception was approved.

Denise (Finance): Also: any mid-cycle enrollments due to qualifying events must be attached with the QE form and the HR ticket id. Payroll needs the ticket id to adjust deductions.

HR Bot: automated: Enrollment checklist created: 'Benefits Open Enrollment 2026' assigned to all employees eligible. Enrollment link: https://benefits.redwood.internal/enroll. Due: 1790006400 (Oct 24 2026).

Ellie (People Ops): Managers  please use this tracking CSV for confirmations (edit access): https://sheets.redwood.internal/benefits-enroll-2026. Paste header to import:

```
manager,employee_email,employee_id,action,doc_submitted_at,doc_filename,hr_ticket_id,notes
```

Noah (Benefits): If someone already uploaded proof in the last 6 months (e.g., newborn paperwork), mark them as 'doc_on_file' with the date and filename. We'll accept that.

Samir (Legal): Keep exports for two years at minimum. People Ops, include a column for 'audit_hash' in the export so we can verify file integrity.

Ellie (People Ops): Good call. I added audit_hash to the sheet and export schema. We'll run a master export after Oct 28 and push to compliance-s3.

Denise (Finance): Can managers request grace periods for employees on unpaid leave?

Ellie (People Ops): Yes  managers should file an HR ticket with dates and justification. We'll record approvals and include ticket ids in the export.

Noah (Benefits): Will contractors be eligible to enroll in company plans? We have a few long-term contractors.

Ellie (People Ops): Contractors on payroll or with a benefits-eligible contract will get an invite. Short-term contractors excluded. Recruiting/Finance will flag eligible SOWs.

HR Bot: reminder scheduled: auto-reminder #1 to managers in 5 days.

Samir (Legal): One more thing: please document consent language for dependent data processing in the enrollment flow. I'll review the copy this afternoon.

Ellie (People Ops): Thanks Samir. I'll update the enrollment notice and post final copy here when done. Closing loop  ping me for bulk exports or extension lists. :white_check_mark:
